title: Read position after one step
statement: Let $R$ be the number of registers, let $\Lambda$ be a set of labels, and let $P$ assign an instruction to each label. For any input bit string $x$ and state $s$ whose read position is at most the length of $x$, the state reached after one step of $P$ on $x$ also has read position at most the length of $x$.
hypotheses_covered: A counter program with $R$ registers and labels in $\Lambda$
The read position of $s$ is at most the length of $x$
replaced:
Let $P$ be a counter program over $R$ registers with labels in $\Lambda$, $x$ an input bit
string, and $s$ an abstract state whose read position $p$ satisfies $p \le |x|$. Then the read
position of the state reached from $s$ by one step of $P$ on $x$ is again at most $|x|$.
